The '''Soda Machine''' is a vending machine that gives the player one [[Joja Cola]] each day.

It is received only upon completing the [[Joja Community Development Form]]. If the player instead decides to build the [[Community Center]] and complete the [[bundles]], this item cannot be obtained.

If the original is lost, a replacement can be purchased at the [[Secret Woods#Lost Items Shop|Lost Items Shop]] in the Secret Woods for {{Price|10000}}.
